content.text:
# service settings ----------------------------------

# Biletado API base URL (change to your tenant)
API_BASE_URL = 'https://your_tenant-api.smart-city-booking.de/api'
TENANT = 'your_tenant'

# credentials for the Buchungsplattform
APP_USERNAME=your_username
APP_PASSWORD=your_password

# Interval for fetching booking tasks (seconds)
FETCH_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 300
# Trigger client refresh every x seconds
CLIENT_REFRESH_SECONDS = 60

# reverse proxy settings (optional) ------------
FQDN=booking-service.example.com
ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.com---
217.154.235.131 your_tenant-api.smart-city-booking.de
dns_exit=0
200
gh_exit=0

observation.command: cp .env.example .env && cat .env; echo ---; getent hosts your_tenant-api.smart-city-booking.de; echo "dns_exit=$?"; curl -sS -m 10 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://github.com 2>&1; echo "gh_exit=$?"
